editor.help_app_summary: XGif is a lightweight capture/edit app that records the Windows screen as GIF or MP4 and lets you trim the result frame by frame.
editor.help_editor_summary: XGif Editor is a built-in editing screen that lets you quickly revise recorded GIFs by frame, timing, size, effects, text, shapes, and pencil overlays.
editor.help_sec_app_summary_body1: The recorder is designed to let you quickly choose the capture area, FPS, resolution, GIF/MP4 output, and GPU usage.
editor.help_sec_app_summary_body2: The editor handles frame deletion, timing adjustments, text/sticker/pencil additions, crop/resize/filter application, and save optimization immediately after recording.
editor.help_sec_flow_body0: 1. Set the capture area and output format on the main screen.
editor.help_sec_flow_body1: 2. After recording, open the editor via the edit button to clean up unnecessary frames and timing.
editor.help_sec_flow_body2: 3. Apply any overlays or effects you need, then save.
editor.help_sec_frames_body0: You can delete selected frames from the frame list or directly edit playback timing.
editor.help_sec_frames_body1: Speed adjustment applies to all frames or only selected frames.
editor.help_sec_frames_body2: Frame reduction removes duplicate or unnecessary frames to reduce file size.
editor.help_sec_image_body0: Crop, resize, rotate, flip left/right and up/down, reverse playback, and yoyo playback are supported.
editor.help_sec_image_body1: Filters handle basic image correction such as brightness, contrast, color, and blur.
editor.help_sec_image_body2: The preview is a work area for checking results before applying; use Apply/Cancel to decide whether to keep the original.
editor.help_sec_overlay_body0: The Add Text tool provides font, size, color, outline, animation, and blink options.
editor.help_sec_overlay_body1: Stickers/shapes and speech bubbles are used to mark emphasis points.
editor.help_sec_overlay_body2: Pencil drawing is an annotation tool for drawing lines directly on frames.
editor.help_sec_design_body0: The wxPython app structure for Windows was retained to avoid increasing the bundle size.
editor.help_sec_design_body1: The UI was organized around a dark theme, unified icons, clear card depth, and a layer structure with low performance overhead.
editor.help_sec_design_body2: Defender bypass and Windows security state modification features were removed from the install/build flow.
